title: Entry queue (GET /api/tournaments/:slug/registrations, 200)
description: Reader: OpenPairings, pulling what the public entry form collected - the one payload that travels back. Request: no body; Authorization as for a publish (an installation key only for its own tournament); X-OpenResults-Key the tournament's key once claimed. The only route that returns email addresses. Oldest first. Refusals: 401 unauthorized; 403 key_required, key_mismatch, not_owner.

id.description: Stable per entry; what the puller de-duplicates on.

received_at.description: This server's clock (the payload's own received_at is the submitter's claim).

registration.description: One entry as the form stored it (OpenResults.Registrations.Entry.to_payload/3). Empty fields are left out rather than sent as null or [].

national_id.description: A STRING: an identifier, not a quantity (KBSB G licences are negative, other federations use letters).
